description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller class named OptionsValueController for managing product option values in an e-commerce application. It provides endpoints for listing, editing, creating, saving, deleting, and removing images of product option values, handling web requests and responses related to product attribute options.

classes.name: OptionsValueController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing product option values, including listing, editing, creating, saving, deleting, and image management functionalities.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of product option values.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the edit form for a specific product option value identified by id.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Prepares and returns the view for creating a new or editing an existing product option value.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a product option value, including validation and image upload.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to provide a paginated list of product options in JSON format.

methods.name: deleteOptionValue
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to delete a specific product option value.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to remove the image associated with a product option value.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu models for navigation in the web interface.
